sentences.text: That study reported that the growth of Pseudoflavonifractor capillosus was among the most strongly enhanced by D-glucosamine.
A shotgun metagenomic study of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease reported that Pseudoflavonifractor capillosus could act as a prognostic organism in overweight or obese subjects.

A Mendelian randomization analysis reported that Pseudoflavonifractor capillosus had adverse effects on chronic kidney disease in type 2 diabetes by downregulating CD25 expression in regulatory T cells.
